verdict.rationale: CrewAI AMP's docs say crews can be deployed 'to a managed infrastructure with a few clicks' and accessed 'via REST API for integration with existing systems'. A documented endpoint set backs this up: POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id} and POST /resume, plus webhook streaming. The unit deployed is a crew (agents plus tasks) rather than a lone agent, and the capability sits in the commercial AMP tier rather than the open-source framework. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that deployment and the API work in practice, and detailed docs on the deployment workflow itself (beyond 'a few clicks', e.g. CLI-driven deploy, auth and scaling)
